goal: Identify mismatches between README.md plus commands/*.md slash-command docs and the Go CLI's actual runtime behavior for run, inspect, escalate, rerun, runs verify, review-context flags, and judge-only recovery guidance.
background: Code surface: cmd/bakeoff/main.go and internal/cli/, internal/verify/, internal/reviewcontext/, internal/workorder/, plus any subcommand wiring for rerun, runs verify, and judge-only recovery flows.
At draft time no commands/rerun.md or commands/verify.md were present; that absence is itself in scope.
Each finding must include: doc reference (file:line or section heading), source reference (file:line), observed mismatch, and a severity judgment.

Mismatch classes to flag: (a) documented but absent from the CLI; (b) implemented but undocumented; (c) divergent semantics (exit codes, defaults, side effects, output format, flag names); (d) judge-only recovery guidance in docs versus how bakeoff rerun --judge-only actually behaves, including which exit codes and run types trigger the recommendation.
Review-context flags in scope: --base, --diff, --changed-files, --no-triage, --no-repo-layout. Confirm doc-vs-code parity, mode binding (research vs build), and user-facing descriptions.
Acceptance: a prioritized list of cited findings; do not produce a patch.

facet.focus: Audit consistency between README.md and commands/*.md slash-command docs and the Go CLI behavior for run, inspect, escalate, rerun, and runs verify, plus review-context flags and judge-only recovery guidance. Surface documented-but-absent, implemented-but-undocumented, and divergent-semantics mismatches with doc and source citations and a severity judgment for each.
include: flags or subcommands documented in README.md or commands/*.md that are absent from the Go CLI
flags or subcommands implemented in the Go CLI but undocumented in README.md or commands/*.md
divergent semantics between docs and code: exit codes, default values, side effects, output format, flag names, mode binding
judge-only recovery guidance parity: docs description versus actual rerun --judge-only behavior, including which exit codes and run types trigger the recommendation
review-context flag parity for --base, --diff, --changed-files, --no-triage, --no-repo-layout including mode binding to research vs build
exclude: style-only or wording-only nits without behavioral consequence
speculation without doc:line and source:line evidence
provider integration internals beyond the surface CLI

unrelated internal packages such as manifest, ledger, fsutil, runner, runlinks, prompt, jsonutil, output, scope, triage, repocontext, buildworkspace, modeldefaults, apperror unless they are surfaced through a CLI flag in scope
